subject: testify() compiler error for array valued function and two matrix arguments

messages.author: 6b3dfa6c2646a8c1
messages.subject: testify() compiler error for array valued function and two matrix arguments
parts:
Hello,

I’ve been using testify() function for rstan, which has greatly helped to test and debug model code.

I’m having trouble with testify() throwing an error when compiling a function with an array return type and two matrix arguments, signature: real[] fn_test3(matrix a, matrix b)

The model compiles and runs fine with the stan() command, but throws an error when invoking testify(). Also it compiles fine for a function with an array return and one matrix argument {real[] fn_test1(matrix a)}, or with a real return and two matrix arguments {real fn_test2(matrix a, matrix b)}.

Attached is the script I used to reproduce the error, and pasted below is the error message and sessionInfo(). Also reproduced the same error on Linux HPC computing cluster. I’m not sure if this intended behaviour or an error. I appreciate any advice.

Many thanks,
Jeff

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: testify() compiler error for array valued function and two matrix arguments
parts:
On Monday, July 13, 2015 at 9:32:19 AM UTC-4, Jeff Eaton wrote:
I’m having trouble with testify() throwing an error when compiling a function with an array return type and two matrix arguments, signature: real[] fn_test3(matrix a, matrix b)

This was fixed a while back. Your fn_test3() compiles with the function formerly known as testify.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stan-dev/rstan/develop/rstan/rstan/R/expose_stan_functions.R

Ben

Jeff

On Monday, July 13, 2015 at 11:56:30 AM UTC-4, Jeff Eaton wrote:
Many thanks Ben.  I had to comment the line '"#include <src/stan/lang/rethrow_located.hpp>",', then worked perfectly.
Yeah, that line was added for Stan 2.7.x and might not be necessary if you are using a previous version of RStan.
